about: Read by scripts/native-artifact-gate.py (D00 T05 §6, §7). A publish folder's size is the sum of its files except the excluded patterns (program databases ship as a separate symbols archive) and the optional_content entries, each {"glob": "<relative glob inside the publish folder>", "decision": "<docs/dev/decisions.md heading that lets it ship separately>"}. Native apps publish to <publish_root>/<App>/<runtime>/ (the C# apps' artifacts/publish/<App>/<runtime>/ is not the native gate's), and every folder there must be named by an app entry: {"<app>": {"mb": <n>, "decision": "<heading>", "publish": ["<folder>", ...]}}, each budget backed by a decisions.md entry whose **Budget:** line states the same number.
